args.question: Requesting controller approval: wire $17,647.86 from the operating account to pay Harbor Logistics (V-579) for approved invoice INV-55521 (due 2026-11-04). It has not been paid yet, and I'll send it only once.

trace.question: Requesting controller approval: wire $17,647.86 from the operating account to pay Harbor Logistics (V-579) for approved invoice INV-55521 (due 2026-11-04). It has not been paid yet, and I'll send it only once.

trace.final:
I paid Harbor Logistics's approved invoice once, by wire from the operating account.

- **Invoice:** INV-55521 (vendor V-579), due 2026-11-04
- **Amount:** $17,647.86, the full invoice amount
- **Payment:** PAY0001, wire, status "sent" and verified

The controller approved it first, because policy requires that for payments over $10,000. Before paying, I checked that no payments had already gone out from the operating account. I also sent the wire with a unique key (`pay-INV-55521`) so a repeated request can't pay it twice.

Harbor Logistics has two other invoices that I didn't pay: INV-22325 ($4,056.71) is still a draft waiting for approval, and INV-82090 was already paid.
